title: Video of the surgeon operating on the alien

tellings.quote: assembled throughout. You've mentioned multiple times that there is a video of him essentially performing surgery on this alien.

plain: There is said to be a video showing a doctor performing surgery on an alien creature in Varginha, a town in Brazil where beings were reportedly captured in 1996. Michels brings it up while interviewing Italo Venturelli, a surgeon who presents himself as a witness to the affair, noting that Venturelli has mentioned "multiple times that there is a video of him essentially performing surgery on this alien." Such a tape would be direct evidence that a living or dead non-human body was handled in a Brazilian hospital.
